active_requirements.text: Support only Tier 0 preflight and Tier 1 human-approved external handoff in v1.5.0; reject apply/destroy, remediation, unattended approvals and unsupported execution profiles.
active_requirements.proof: Scope/RFC review and unsupported-mode rejection corpus

active_requirements.text: Resolve each human decision from a verified human principal; caller actor/role headers cannot establish identity.
Bootstrap the first local operator through an operator-held one-use setup credential with no default account/password; provide a documented secured account-recovery procedure.
active_requirements.proof: Bootstrap replay/default-credential tests and recovery exercise

active_requirements.text: Enforce human session expiry, logout and revocation with protected cookies and CSRF defenses for browser mutations.
active_requirements.proof: Session lifecycle, cookie and CSRF test matrix

active_requirements.text: Distinguish human, service, agent and runner credentials; nonhuman credentials cannot obtain human sessions, publish workflows or decide approvals.
Derive project/workspace capabilities from server-owned memberships, denying absent membership and cross-scope access by default.
Protect automation-linked report, policy, settings and artifact paths against bypass through legacy caller-controlled scope or role inputs.
active_requirements.proof: Legacy-route and linked-object bypass regression tests

active_requirements.text: Enforce distinct requester/approver identities in shared mode; label authenticated single-operator decisions as acknowledgement with no separation-of-duties claim.
Publish a versioned workflow schema with typed, bounded inputs and explicit supported step input/output contracts.
Validate definitions without side effects using bounded YAML bytes/depth/aliases, duplicate-key rejection and an acyclic graph capped at 50 steps.

Accept only the closed P0 registry: supported artifact intake, OpenTofu/Terraform collection, analyze, policy gate, approval and GitHub handoff; reject arbitrary scripts/plugins, loops and generic failure/finally execution.
Resolve only typed substitution references to inputs, declared step outputs and run/project metadata; reject unknown references, functions and code evaluation.
Require every executable path to a handoff to pass its mandatory successful evidence analysis, policy gate and matching approval; skipped/failed or unrelated ancestors do not qualify.
Scope workflow drafts and revisions to one project and optional workspace.
Keep published revisions immutable; restore creates a new draft, and drafts cannot execute.

Snapshot the published definition, validated inputs, scope and source identity immutably when a run starts; require a repository commit for collected/exact-plan paths and explicitly mark unavailable source for upload-only advisory review.
active_requirements.proof: Post-start mutation and rerun snapshot tests

active_requirements.text: Disable, revoke or restore epoch changes must invalidate unconsumed grants and prevent new run starts, collection claims, dispatch or grant consumption while preserving read and reconciliation for accepted external work.
Persist run/step transitions and explicit `stopped_by_gate`, `expired`, `timed_out`, `cancelled`, `failed`, `succeeded` and `delivery_unknown` outcomes across restart.
active_requirements.proof: Crash at each transition with state recovery assertions

active_requirements.text: Fence leader/task attempts so only the current owner may heartbeat, log, upload or complete a task.
active_requirements.proof: Overlapping leader and stale-attempt rejection tests

active_requirements.text: Retry only declared safe/idempotent local work within finite deadlines; persist idempotent outputs and reconcile uncertain external work instead of blind resend.
Record cancellation durably and terminate the owned runner process tree; explain that cancellation cannot undo accepted external work.
active_requirements.proof: Cancellation/dispatch races and process-tree termination tests

active_requirements.text: Bound per-workflow/project concurrency, backlog, analysis workers and storage usage with explicit quota/backpressure errors.
Allow runner-less upload of currently supported artifact formats through existing scoped intake protections.
active_requirements.proof: Uploaded-artifact vertical slice and size/type/traversal tests

active_requirements.text: Screen inputs, metadata, streamed logs, errors and artifacts before persistence or analysis; reject state/credential/key/binary-plan uploads and inline secret-looking values.
active_requirements.proof: Secret corpus including chunk boundaries and blocked-file tests

active_requirements.text: Record authenticated collection provenance with runner/task attempt, command/argv digest, source SHA, exit code, time, raw-local digest, sanitized digest and redaction version; recompute received digests.
active_requirements.proof: Tampered digest, stale attempt and redaction-provenance tests

active_requirements.text: Invoke the existing shared analysis core without duplicating risk logic; provenance alone cannot turn inferred output into deterministic evidence.
active_requirements.proof: Cross-surface report parity and Evidence Law fixtures

active_requirements.text: Link runs to immutable reports through a compatible versioned optional provenance contract; retain permanent report URLs and existing report consumers.
Expose missing/partial/stale collection as confidence limitations and context TODOs; failed or incomplete mandatory collection cannot make approval eligible.
Keep deterministic automation usable with AI disabled or narrative failure, and preserve existing structured-summary/local-only provider boundaries without new AI composition.
Pause for a human decision durably with a finite deadline and never auto-approve on restart, expiry or missing reviewer.

Bind approval to authorization kind, revision, source identity and required exact-plan commit, project/workspace/environment, reports, artifact and unit-plan digests, policy version, exact target and payload digest.
active_requirements.proof: Independent mutation of every decision-tuple field

active_requirements.text: Enforce evidence freshness at decision, dispatch and receiver consumption; default collection TTL is 60 minutes unless an audited stricter policy applies.
Evaluate explicit workflow policy separately from advisory report semantics, preserving canonical should_block=False and using existing policy-adapter field meanings where compatible.
active_requirements.proof: Gate decision versus advisory report contract tests

active_requirements.text: Require an explicit authenticated approve/reject decision and reason when the canonical recommendation is `no-go`, severity is high/critical or the separate typed `insufficient_context` flag is true, with typed confirmation for high/critical.
active_requirements.proof: Reason/confirmation API denial and keyboard decision E2E

active_requirements.text: Invalidate eligibility when evidence, revision, source, scope, target, policy, membership or custody changes, expires or is superseded; no emergency bypass or delegated approval in P0.

Register outbound GitHub destinations with administrator-controlled host policy; revalidate DNS/connection addresses and redirects, blocking metadata/loopback/private targets except explicit audited internal-host exceptions.
Atomically persist the approved outbound intent and exact payload before network effects, with a stable receiver operation identity.
Issue one-use scoped receiver grants bound to the decision tuple, operation, expiry and live epoch; reject duplicate/replayed or altered consumption.
Consume grants into a durable receiver operation record before external action so a consume-before-action crash resumes the same operation without a second action.

Distinguish dispatch acceptance, externally observed completion and delivery_unknown; reconcile unknown outcomes through receiver receipts and never report dispatch acceptance as successful deployment.
active_requirements.proof: Lost-response/poll/receipt fault matrix and UI semantic tests

active_requirements.text: Authorize exact-plan handoff only when the qualified self-hosted receiver can verify the original immutable saved-plan bytes in protected local custody by opaque handle, raw digest and expiry; no server/public-artifact plan storage, and replanning requires fresh evidence/approval. Upload-only advisory receipts never authorize apply or require invented repository provenance.
active_requirements.proof: Real custody access/restart/overwrite/symlink/expiry/replan spike and receiver tests

active_requirements.text: Canonicalize target lock identities across aliases and retain locks during unknown external work until verified resolution or an audited operator break that does not mint a new authorization.
Verify receiver callback signatures, operation/run/source identity and replay protection using the pinned GitHub adapter version and protected branch/tag dispatch ref.
active_requirements.proof: API-version, callback replay and mutable-ref substitution contract tests

active_requirements.text: Enroll runners using one-use tokens and project-scoped expiring credentials with rotation/revocation and outbound HTTPS protocol-version negotiation.
Bind every task claim, heartbeat, log, upload and completion to the authorized runner, project, current attempt and live lease.
Route collection to eligible runner tags with no silent fallback; fail clearly when none qualify or enforce an explicit finite wait, and expose last-seen/version/task health.

Collect only from admitted trusted immutable sources in disposable isolated workspaces with canonical-root/symlink containment and controlled tool/provider installation; reject untrusted PR sources and inherited Git/hooks/config.
Execute only operator-protected fixed catalog commands with validated parameters; reject arbitrary shell, server-defined commands and app Docker-socket access.

Qualify OpenTofu/Terraform plan and JSON extraction for declared pinned versions, distinguishing exit 0/no-change, 2/change and error; retain the sensitive binary plan locally and transport screened JSON only.
active_requirements.proof: Real-tool compatibility smoke and hostile/sensitive plan fixtures

active_requirements.text: Resolve infrastructure credentials only in the operator-owned runner/receiver execution identities under an environment allow-list and least privilege; never send or persist their values in DeployWhisper.
active_requirements.proof: Credential inheritance/transport/persistence corpus and separated-identity spike

active_requirements.text: Enforce task CPU/time/disk/output/egress caps and atomic bounded uploads with cleanup after failure; cancellation must terminate the entire owned process tree.
active_requirements.proof: Limit, partial-upload, disk-full, egress and descendant-process tests

active_requirements.text: Provide sanctioned React navigation, validated templates/YAML draft/publish controls and scoped workflow/run lists using actual APIs and existing design primitives without changing Dashboard information budget.
active_requirements.proof: Compose-built workflow creation and scoped-list keyboard/a11y E2E

active_requirements.text: Show immutable run timeline, screened logs, artifact digests, linked briefing, uncertainty and permanent report provenance links with loading/empty/error/disabled/degraded states.
active_requirements.proof: Compose-built run/history/report states and real-data E2E

active_requirements.text: Provide a scoped approval inbox and keyboard-operable decision screen showing exact evidence, target/payload, freshness, policy, confidence, blast radius and rollback context with acknowledgement labeling.
Expose runner health, collection/cancel progress and unknown/reconciliation state with advisory copy that never claims Tier 0/1 deploys infrastructure.
active_requirements.proof: Real-runner composed E2E and unknown-state copy checks

active_requirements.text: Accept only human-declared unit inventory and dependencies; validate exact unit coverage/cycles/unknown identities, persist deterministic preflight waves and combined evidence digest, and show accessible scope/lock tables without claiming deployment ordering.
active_requirements.proof: Multi-unit exact-cover/cycle/digest tests and accessible table E2E

active_requirements.text: Start scoped runs manually or through signed timestamped replay-resistant webhook intake with typed inputs, idempotency, source pinning and bounded errors/quotas; record trigger origin and principal.
Expose versioned automation API and CLI validation/run/status/list/decision commands over the same authority, envelopes and generated SPA types; agent read/request mode cannot decide or publish.
active_requirements.proof: API/CLI/OpenAPI parity and nonhuman-mutation denial tests

active_requirements.text: Record append-only application audit events with verified principal/type, role, scope, target, reason, time and before/after digests; expose scoped UI/JSON export without raw artifacts/secrets and document DB-admin trust limits.
active_requirements.proof: Audit event coverage/export authorization and secret corpus

active_requirements.text: Let authorized operators configure feature enablement, targets, quotas, retention, TTL and credential lifetimes; reject unsafe reductions, protect pending evidence or invalidate its decision before deletion, and audit each change.
active_requirements.proof: Configuration permissions, pending-retention and floor-change tests

active_requirements.text: The declared crash/race corpus must lose no committed run/decision state and produce no unauthorized or duplicate receiver action, including stale attempts, unknown delivery and restore epochs.
active_requirements.proof: Published fault-injection results at every persisted boundary

active_requirements.text: The declared principal × role × project/workspace × object/action matrix must produce zero cross-scope reads or unauthorized mutations.
The versioned sensitive-data corpus must yield zero known secret patterns in stored artifacts/logs/metadata/errors/audit or transmitted narrative summaries; no universal-redaction claim follows.
active_requirements.proof: Stored/output corpus scans including chunk boundaries

active_requirements.text: Automation-originated fixture reports must produce zero Evidence Law violations and preserve deterministic/inferred labels and advisory report semantics.
active_requirements.proof: Evidence Law and cross-surface contract CI results

active_requirements.text: Ready-step server orchestration overhead must have p95 <1 second, excluding collection/network/analysis duration, under the reproducible reference workload.
Enqueue-to-claim latency must have p95 <2 seconds with 20 online compatible runners under the reference workload.
The singleton SQLite profile must sustain 10 active runs with at most 2 concurrent analysis jobs and 20 online runners, with bounded queue/storage and no corrupted transitions.
active_requirements.proof: 30-minute capacity/saturation run with resource and error report

active_requirements.text: Workflow validation must have p95 <500 milliseconds for the declared 50-step workflow corpus under the reference workload.

All new React routes must pass the composed-app axe critical/serious violation gate and keyboard-only create/run/review/decision/recovery journeys, using real API-backed seeded data and required screenshots.
active_requirements.proof: Compose production build, Playwright/axe/keyboard results and screenshots

active_requirements.text: Upgrade from a v1.4.0 database copy, interrupted upgrade, coordinated DB/artifact backup/restore, token rotation and restricted-network recovery must preserve auditable state while invalidating outstanding authorization/leases until reconciled.
Publish version-matched schema/API/CLI/operator/security/support-limit docs with CI link/drift checks and secret-free run/queue/step/runner/approval/delivery metrics plus troubleshooting runbooks.
active_requirements.proof: Docs CI and operator self-service installation/recovery pilot

active_requirements.text: Stable v1.5.0 requires signed app/runner artifacts, SBOM/checksums/provenance, named tool/receiver support matrix, full application CI, independent review and supported-profile pilot with no unresolved introduced critical/high defect.

original_dispositions.original_text: Workflows are declarative YAML with `schema: deploywhisper.workflow/v1` and a published JSON Schema in `schemas/`.
original_dispositions.rationale: Versioned bounded workflow contract retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Validation (API, CLI, UI) checks syntax, schema, references, DAG acyclicity, tier rules, approval-ancestor rule, and guardrail floors with no side effects.
original_dispositions.rationale: Validation strengthened to all-path evidence/action binding.

original_dispositions.original_text: Only step types in the closed registry are accepted; unknown types are rejected with field-level errors.
original_dispositions.rationale: Closed P0 registry replaces broad catalog.

original_dispositions.original_text: Templating is substitution-only (`${{ inputs.x }}`, `${{ steps.id.outputs.y }}`, `${{ run.id }}`, `${{ project.key }}`); no function calls, loops, or code evaluation.
original_dispositions.rationale: Substitution-only typed references retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Typed inputs (`string`, `integer`, `boolean`, `select`, `artifact`) with pattern/enum/min/max validation; webhook inputs validated identically. `artifact` lets a user upload a file for a run, enabling runner-less workflows.
original_dispositions.rationale: Typed inputs validated identically at intake.

original_dispositions.original_text: Secrets are referenced by name (`*_ref`); inline secret-looking values are rejected.
original_dispositions.rationale: Reject inline secrets; runner references remain local.

original_dispositions.original_text: Revisions: draft, publish, history, restore as new draft. Drafts are never executed. Published revisions are immutable.
original_dispositions.rationale: Immutable published revision and restore-as-draft retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Every workflow is scoped to a project and optional workspace.
original_dispositions.rationale: Project/workspace scope retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Steps declare `needs` forming a DAG; independent branches may run in parallel; default maximum of 50 steps.
original_dispositions.rationale: Bounded acyclic graph and immutable snapshot retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Per-step `retries` and `timeout`; workflow-level `on_failure` and `finally`.
original_dispositions.rationale: Finite safe retries/timeouts adopted; generic on_failure/finally deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Per-workflow concurrency limit and per-project run quota.
original_dispositions.rationale: Quotas moved into P0 safety boundary.

original_dispositions.original_text: Starter templates in `examples/infra-automation/` (non-executable YAML), each validated in CI.
original_dispositions.rationale: Validated templates ship with supported profile.

original_dispositions.original_text: Git-based read-only import of workflow YAML and promotion between workspaces with a diff.
original_dispositions.rationale: Git import/promotion deferred beyond 1.5.

original_dispositions.original_text: Visual (no-code) builder synchronized with YAML.
original_dispositions.rationale: Visual builder deferred; YAML/templates are P0.

original_dispositions.original_text: `orchestrate` block that expands a stage plan into explicit per-stage steps at run start (Section 10.3).
original_dispositions.rationale: Dynamic stage expansion deferred; explicit manual preflight waves replace it.

original_dispositions.original_text: Manual start from UI, API, CLI with typed input validation.
original_dispositions.rationale: Authenticated manual/API/CLI starts retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Inbound webhook with per-trigger token (hashed at rest), constant-time compare, optional HMAC-SHA256, timestamp tolerance, replay protection.
original_dispositions.rationale: Mandatory raw-byte HMAC plus replay/timestamp controls replaces optional signature.

original_dispositions.original_text: Webhook idempotency key prevents duplicate runs.
original_dispositions.rationale: Idempotent intake promoted to P0.

original_dispositions.original_text: Every run records trigger type, actor, surface, and reference.
original_dispositions.rationale: Typed verified actor/origin replaces caller identity.

original_dispositions.original_text: Runs started by agent or automation tokens cannot skip approvals or start workflows containing `execute.*` steps.
original_dispositions.rationale: Nonhuman decision/publish denial; all execute steps excluded.

original_dispositions.original_text: Schedule trigger (cron, timezone, optional calendar skip) including drift-detection templates.
original_dispositions.rationale: Cron/timezone/drift engine deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Event triggers: `analysis.completed` (internal) and GitHub pull-request events through the existing integration.
original_dispositions.rationale: PR context may use signed intake; native internal/GitHub event orchestration deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Run and step state is persisted as a state machine; in-flight runs resume after restart.
original_dispositions.rationale: Durable explicit state and restart recovery retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: The engine runs inside the existing FastAPI process with no new infrastructure dependency (ADR-14); a DB lease prevents two engine leaders.
original_dispositions.rationale: Singleton engine requires fenced ownership, not an unfenced lease.

original_dispositions.original_text: Transitions are persisted before side effects; at-least-once delivery with idempotency keys.
original_dispositions.rationale: Persist-before-effect strengthened with receiver reconciliation.

original_dispositions.original_text: Cancel a run; runner tasks cancelled best-effort; final state recorded.
original_dispositions.rationale: Cancellation qualified with process tree and external-action caveat.

original_dispositions.original_text: Explicit terminal states: `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled`, `stopped_by_gate`, `expired`, `timed_out`.
original_dispositions.rationale: Delivery_unknown added to explicit state semantics.

original_dispositions.original_text: Inputs, outputs, and logs persisted only after redaction (extends 12.1/12.3).
original_dispositions.rationale: Screen every persisted output/metadata path.

original_dispositions.original_text: Runs link to the report(s) from their `analyze` steps; reruns compare using the existing report diff.
original_dispositions.rationale: Immutable report linkage adopted; new automation rerun comparison UX deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Configurable retention (defaults: runs 90 days, artifacts 30 days).
original_dispositions.rationale: Retention protects pending decisions and bounded storage.

original_dispositions.original_text: Multi-instance-safe claiming for PostgreSQL (`SKIP LOCKED` or equivalent).
original_dispositions.rationale: PostgreSQL multi-instance claims require later ADR and qualification.

original_dispositions.original_text: Runner is a subcommand of the existing package and connects **outbound** over HTTPS only.
original_dispositions.rationale: Outbound HTTPS runner and negotiated protocol retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Enrollment via one-time token; runner token is project-scoped, hashed server-side, revocable, expiring, shown once.
original_dispositions.rationale: One-use enrollment and credential lifecycle retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Tag routing (`runner.tags`, all-of by default). No eligible runner -> fail fast; `fallback: wait` needs `max_wait`.
original_dispositions.rationale: Strict routing and finite wait retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Heartbeats and leases; lost tasks re-queued only for steps declared `idempotent`.
original_dispositions.rationale: Fenced attempts and safe-only requeue strengthen lease semantics.

original_dispositions.original_text: Runner-side **command catalog**: fixed argv templates plus parameter schemas; the server sends only `command_id` and validated parameters.
original_dispositions.rationale: Operator-protected fixed catalog retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Secrets and cloud credentials are resolved on the runner; the server never stores or receives them.
original_dispositions.rationale: Local credentials and distinct receiver identity required.

original_dispositions.original_text: Per-task working directory, environment allow-list, output caps, timeouts; optional container profile documented.
original_dispositions.rationale: Isolation promoted from optional container suggestion to required qualified profile.

original_dispositions.original_text: Protocol version negotiation; incompatible runners refused with an actionable message.
original_dispositions.rationale: Protocol compatibility promoted to P0.

original_dispositions.original_text: Runner health (last seen, version, tags, current task) in UI and API.
original_dispositions.rationale: Runner health retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Server-side steps run in-process and need no runner.
original_dispositions.rationale: Runner-less server analysis path retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Runner-side custom commands only via a local allow-list file owned by the runner operator.
original_dispositions.rationale: Custom command extensibility deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Mutual TLS and signed task envelopes.
original_dispositions.rationale: Alternative mTLS/signed-envelope profiles deferred; authenticated scoped HTTPS is P0.

original_dispositions.original_text: Optional runner setting `require_ephemeral_credentials`: refuse tasks when only long-lived static cloud keys are detected; documentation for workload identity/OIDC.
original_dispositions.rationale: Least-privilege credential separation adopted; automatic static-key detection flag deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: `collect.terraform_plan` (OpenTofu or Terraform binary chosen by the runner catalog)
original_dispositions.rationale: Only qualified OpenTofu/Terraform automated collector adopted.

original_dispositions.original_text: `collect.ansible_check`
original_dispositions.rationale: Ansible check collector needs separate parser/isolation qualification.

original_dispositions.original_text: `collect.kubectl_diff`
original_dispositions.rationale: kubectl diff collector deferred; supported uploads still available.

original_dispositions.original_text: `collect.helm_template`
original_dispositions.rationale: Helm collector deferred; supported uploads still available.

original_dispositions.original_text: `collect.git_diff`
original_dispositions.rationale: Git diff collector deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: `analyze` (shared orchestrator)
original_dispositions.rationale: Shared-core analyze retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: `scanner.import` (Epic 8)
original_dispositions.rationale: Existing supported scanner intake reused; dedicated workflow scanner.import deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: `gate.verdict`
original_dispositions.rationale: Separate policy gate retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: `approval`
original_dispositions.rationale: Durable verified-human decision retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: `notify.slack_webhook`, `notify.github_pr_comment`
original_dispositions.rationale: Slack/PR notification steps deferred; in-app inbox P0.

original_dispositions.original_text: `handoff.webhook`, `handoff.github_dispatch`
original_dispositions.rationale: GitHub receiver contract adopted; arbitrary webhook adapter deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: `collect.kustomize_build`, `collect.terragrunt_plan`, `collect.cloudformation_changeset`
original_dispositions.rationale: Additional collector adapters deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: `handoff.jenkins`, `handoff.gitlab_pipeline`, `itsm.callback`
original_dispositions.rationale: Jenkins/GitLab/ITSM adapters deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: `packages.inspect` (build/refresh the package inventory for selected units)
original_dispositions.rationale: Package inventory step deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: `wait` (delay or until callback)
original_dispositions.rationale: Generic wait/callback orchestration step deferred; receiver reconciliation is domain-specific.

original_dispositions.original_text: `execute.*`
original_dispositions.rationale: Tier2 execute excluded pending separate RFC/product decision.

original_dispositions.original_text: `approval` pauses the run durably; the pause survives restarts and never auto-approves.
original_dispositions.rationale: Durable finite pause with no auto-approval retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Assignment by users and/or project roles with `min_approvals`.
original_dispositions.rationale: Assignments derive from verified membership; no caller-provided role authority.

original_dispositions.original_text: Optional `separation_of_duties` (requester cannot approve); unavailable and labeled in single-operator mode.
original_dispositions.rationale: Separation of duties and acknowledgement-only labeling retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Typed decision payload (`approved`, `reason`, declared fields) becomes step output.
original_dispositions.rationale: Explicit typed decision and audit retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Evidence pinning**: records `report_id`, artifact sha256 digests, and (Phase B) plan-snapshot digest; any change or supersession invalidates the approval.
original_dispositions.rationale: Full immutable evidence/action tuple replaces report digest alone.

original_dispositions.original_text: Approval card shows verdict, score, Evidence Law status, confidence, top findings, blast radius, rollback summary, context TODOs, plan age, AI-involvement indicator, and the exact handoff target.
original_dispositions.rationale: Exact briefing/target/freshness decision context retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Stale-evidence warning when pinned collection exceeds the TTL (default 60 min).
original_dispositions.rationale: TTL enforcement promoted to P0 at decision/dispatch/consume.

original_dispositions.original_text: Reason required for `no_go`, `severity >= high`, `insufficient_context`; high/critical additionally requires typed confirmation. Thresholds follow GRD-8.
original_dispositions.rationale: Required reason and confirmation retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Expiry ends in `expired` (run fails), never approval.
original_dispositions.rationale: Expiry cannot authorize action.

original_dispositions.original_text: Agent and automation tokens cannot approve or reject; attempts are denied and audited.
original_dispositions.rationale: Typed nonhuman credentials cannot decide.

original_dispositions.original_text: Approvals inbox with filters, sidebar badge, and deep links from notifications.
original_dispositions.rationale: Scoped inbox retained; notification deep links deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Emergency bypass per PRD 19.2 (reason, actor, timestamp, audit); disabled by default.
original_dispositions.rationale: Emergency bypass excluded P0.

original_dispositions.original_text: Reassign or delegate an approval.
original_dispositions.rationale: Delegation/reassignment deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Per-stage approvals with the stage plan digest pinned.
original_dispositions.rationale: Declared whole-preflight plan digest adopted; per-deployment-stage approvals deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Collected artifacts enter normal intake: classification, sensitive-file handling (`*.tfstate`, keys, credentials never ingested), project/workspace scoping.
original_dispositions.rationale: Normal sensitive-file scoped intake retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Provenance per artifact: run, step, runner id, `command_id`, argv digest, exit code, `collected_at`, sha256.
original_dispositions.rationale: Provenance includes separate raw/sanitized digests and current attempt.

original_dispositions.original_text: New evidence `source_type` `automation_collection` is `deterministic` only with complete provenance; otherwise downgraded to `user_provided`.
original_dispositions.rationale: Metadata authenticity adopted; automatic deterministic source_type promotion rejected.

original_dispositions.original_text: Infra Automation never creates or changes findings, severity, or Evidence Law status.
original_dispositions.rationale: Automation cannot rewrite scoring/Evidence Law/advisory semantics.

original_dispositions.original_text: Collection limitations become confidence factors and context TODOs (check-mode gaps, plan age, plan-apply drift, partial collection).
original_dispositions.rationale: Coverage/freshness limitations retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Terraform plan `sensitive` values are redacted before storage or analysis.
original_dispositions.rationale: Screened JSON transported; raw plan remains local.

original_dispositions.original_text: Report schema gains an additive optional `automation` block; `report_schema_version` increments; docs updated.
original_dispositions.rationale: Versioned additive contract adopted; automatic minor-version bump not assumed.

original_dispositions.original_text: Step logs/outputs are untrusted text for narrative generation; prompt-injection tests cover them.
original_dispositions.rationale: Untrusted output screening and existing narrative boundaries retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: CI fixtures verify automation-originated reports satisfy the Evidence Law (EVD-12 extended).
original_dispositions.rationale: Bounded Evidence Law regression corpus required.

original_dispositions.original_text: Infra map schema `deploywhisper.infra-map/v1` (units, layers, runner tags, owners, depends_on, package allow-lists) with JSON Schema and validator.
original_dispositions.rationale: Human-declared unit/dependency map adopted; package fields deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Deterministic unit detection from repository content and changed paths (file patterns) with evidence for each detected unit.
original_dispositions.rationale: Automatic unit detection deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Dependency graph with per-edge `basis` (Section 7.4) and confidence; only enforcing bases constrain order.
original_dispositions.rationale: Explicit dependency evidence adopted; inferred graph edges deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: A stage plan is valid only if it respects all enforcing edges and covers exactly the change set; invalid plans are rejected with reasons.
original_dispositions.rationale: Exact-cover preflight waves adopted; deployment stage plan excluded.

original_dispositions.original_text: Limitations are surfaced: missing map, stale map, undeterminable edges, AI-inferred edges - as context TODOs, never silent.
original_dispositions.rationale: Missing/stale map limitations explicit.

original_dispositions.original_text: Plan snapshot (units, edges, waves, rationale, digest) persisted with the run and pinned by approvals.
original_dispositions.rationale: Immutable declared unit-plan digest retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: `orchestrate` expansion generates explicit per-stage *collect, analyze, gate, approval, handoff* steps at run start; the expanded definition is stored and validated by the same validator.
original_dispositions.rationale: Dynamic per-stage deployment orchestration excluded P0.

original_dispositions.original_text: Environment promotion `dev -> stage -> prod` with per-environment approvals and a promotion diff (report and package versions).
original_dispositions.rationale: Environment promotion engine deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Cross-unit bundle analysis plus per-stage analyses; cross-unit interaction findings reference all contributing units.
original_dispositions.rationale: Combined supported-artifact analysis adopted; stage-specific deployment analyses deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Target locks keyed `<unit_id>:<workspace>`, held until handoff completion/cancel/expiry; audited admin break.
original_dispositions.rationale: Canonical locks elevated to P0 with unknown-outcome retention.

original_dispositions.original_text: Change windows and freeze periods per workspace; out-of-window approvals need an audited exception reason.
original_dispositions.rationale: Change windows/freeze exceptions deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Lock and window state visible in UI and API; conflicts produce explicit messages.
original_dispositions.rationale: Lock visibility/conflicts adopted; window state deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Parsers for `.terraform.lock.hcl` and module calls (plan JSON `module_calls` / HCL), `Chart.yaml`/`Chart.lock`, Ansible `requirements.yml`, Kubernetes image references, Kustomize remote bases, registered through the parser registry.
original_dispositions.rationale: Cross-ecosystem package parsers/governance deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Package inventory per unit and per run using the package reference schema (Section 7.2).
original_dispositions.rationale: Package inventory domain deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Per-project, per-workspace **package ledger** supporting first-seen, version-changed, and hash-changed-without-version-change detection.
original_dispositions.rationale: Package ledger and baseline semantics deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Deterministic package signals (Section 7.2) feed the existing risk engine as evidence and public risk patterns; severity remains governed by Evidence Law.
original_dispositions.rationale: New package risk signals require separate benchmarks.

original_dispositions.original_text: Admin-managed package allow-list (registries, namespaces, images); non-allow-listed sources are flagged; GRD-5 enforces for workflows.
original_dispositions.rationale: Protected tool/provider source admission adopted for runner; package-wide allow-list governance deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: First-seen packages require explicit human acknowledgement in the approval card.
original_dispositions.rationale: First-seen package acknowledgement deferred with ledger.

original_dispositions.original_text: Registry lookups are off by default; an opt-in, user-owned connector (including MCP-based registry access) may add `external` evidence with freshness and source labels.
original_dispositions.rationale: Registry connector remains absent/off; future opt-in only.

original_dispositions.original_text: AI cannot add, upgrade, or approve packages (IAU-AI-11).
original_dispositions.rationale: AI authority prohibition retained; package-specific advisor/domain deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: New public risk patterns for package signals ship with benchmark scenarios and false-positive notes.
original_dispositions.rationale: Package public patterns and false-positive qualification deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: AI is optional; each capability has a deterministic fallback; the feature is fully usable with AI off.
original_dispositions.rationale: Existing deterministic AI-off narrative path adopted; new capability fallbacks deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: AI output is schema-constrained IR; strict parse; unknown fields rejected.
original_dispositions.rationale: New schema-constrained AI IR subsystem deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: All AI output passes the validator, guardrail floors, registry checks, and package allow-list; failures are never shown as usable results.
original_dispositions.rationale: AI workflow validation pipeline deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Repair loop of at most two attempts using validator errors only.
original_dispositions.rationale: AI repair loop deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Deterministic renderer converts IR to YAML/map/plan; the model never emits YAML, shell, or executable commands.
original_dispositions.rationale: AI IR renderer deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Results are proposals shown as diffs; **Apply to draft**, **Publish**, **Run**, **Approve** are separate explicit human actions.
original_dispositions.rationale: Explicit human publish/decision boundaries adopted; AI diff proposals deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Origin labels on items; revisions record `authored_by` and `ai_run_id`s.
original_dispositions.rationale: Verified authorship/audit retained; AI-run provenance for new capabilities deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Untrusted-input handling: prompt isolation, structured inputs, size caps; injection test suite extended with infra-automation fixtures.
original_dispositions.rationale: Existing untrusted narrative protections retained; new Composer/Mapper corpus deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Provider unavailable/invalid/timeout falls back to the deterministic path with a clear message.
original_dispositions.rationale: Existing narrative failure fallback retained; new structured AI capabilities deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Local-only mode honored; data-minimization rules (Section 8.5) enforced; external providers receive structured summaries only.
original_dispositions.rationale: Existing local-only/structured-summary boundary retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: AI cannot add steps outside the registry, units outside the change set, packages outside the allow-list, or lower/disable floors.
original_dispositions.rationale: AI cannot create authority or lower registry floors; package-specific controls deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: AI interaction audit records (Section 8.7), included in audit export.
original_dispositions.rationale: Existing principal audit retained; new AI orchestration records deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: AI evaluation corpus, metrics, and release gate; zero-tolerance metrics as listed in Section 8.9.
original_dispositions.rationale: New AI evaluation corpus belongs with later AI feature.

original_dispositions.original_text: Rate limits, size caps, timeouts, per-user budgets; no background AI calls without a user action unless an admin enables optional auto-diagnosis (off by default).
original_dispositions.rationale: New AI budgets/auto-diagnosis controls deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: AI requests originating from agent/automation tokens are treated as untrusted and cannot trigger publish or approval paths.
original_dispositions.rationale: Nonhuman publish/approval denial adopted; new AI request surface deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Workflow Composer (Draft, Explain, Review).
original_dispositions.rationale: Workflow Composer deferred beyond 1.5.

original_dispositions.original_text: Infra Mapper.
original_dispositions.rationale: Infra Mapper deferred beyond 1.5.

original_dispositions.original_text: Orchestration Planner (suggestions marked `ai_inferred` until accepted).
original_dispositions.rationale: AI Orchestration Planner deferred beyond 1.5.

original_dispositions.original_text: Run Diagnostician with rule-based failure signatures as the baseline.
original_dispositions.rationale: AI Diagnostician deferred; actionable deterministic errors required.

original_dispositions.original_text: Package Advisor using only local inputs by default.
original_dispositions.rationale: Package Advisor deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Floors GRD-1..GRD-10 (Section 8.6) enforced at save, publish, and run time.
original_dispositions.rationale: Applicable P0 guardrails adopted; original package/AI/promotion floors not implied.

original_dispositions.original_text: Floors cannot be created, edited, or lowered by AI, by agent tokens, or by workflow content.
original_dispositions.rationale: Workflow/nonhuman inputs cannot lower authority floors.

original_dispositions.original_text: Project Admins may raise floors where marked configurable; every change is audited.
original_dispositions.rationale: Operator tightening adopted; future package/promotion configuration deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Blast-radius thresholds (severity, `no_go`, `insufficient_context`, services affected, environment tier) drive mandatory approval and reason requirements.
original_dispositions.rationale: Explicit policy and elevated-decision requirements retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Floors reuse the Epic 11 policy-adapter field names and semantics where they exist.
original_dispositions.rationale: Existing policy-adapter semantics reused where compatible.

original_dispositions.original_text: Append-only events for workflow create/edit/publish/archive, run start/cancel, approval requested/decided/expired, runner enroll/revoke, token create/rotate, setting and floor changes, AI interactions, lock breaks, and denied actions.
original_dispositions.rationale: All supported P0 lifecycle/denial events retained; deferred AI/window domains not invented.

original_dispositions.original_text: Each event records actor, role, surface, project, workspace, target, timestamp, reason, and before/after digest.
original_dispositions.rationale: Verified typed principal and before/after digests required.

original_dispositions.original_text: Viewable in UI, exportable as JSON, retention configurable.
original_dispositions.rationale: Scoped UI/export and retention retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: No secrets or raw artifact content in audit (tested).
original_dispositions.rationale: Secret/raw-content audit exclusion tested.

original_dispositions.original_text: REST endpoints under `/api/v1/infra-automation/` for workflows, revisions, validation, runs, approvals, runners, audit, stats, AI, and (Phase B) inventory, packages, plans, locks. Use the existing `{data, meta}` and error envelopes and Pydantic models.
original_dispositions.rationale: Supported automation endpoints retained; AI/packages/planner catalogs deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Endpoints enforce project scope and role checks; unauthorized access returns bounded errors that do not reveal existence.
original_dispositions.rationale: Trusted scope and existence-bounded errors retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: `GET /api/v1/infra-automation/stats/summary` for page KPIs and sparklines with the same optional scope filters as `/stats/summary`.
original_dispositions.rationale: Real scoped status/health UI data adopted; optional sparklines not mandatory.

original_dispositions.original_text: CLI under `deploywhisper infra-automation`: `validate`, `run`, `status`, `approve`, `list`, `compose` (AI draft to stdout); and `deploywhisper runner`: `enroll`, `start`, `status`.
original_dispositions.rationale: Supported CLI/runner commands adopted; compose command deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: `--agent-json` read/request-only equivalents; no approve or publish.
original_dispositions.rationale: Agent read/request boundary retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: OpenAPI types for the SPA regenerated through the existing generation step.
original_dispositions.rationale: Generated SPA types and OpenAPI parity retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Enable/disable per instance and per project.
original_dispositions.rationale: Disable semantics strengthened to outstanding grants and reconciliation.

original_dispositions.original_text: Configure allowed outbound hosts, quotas, retention, approval TTL defaults, runner token lifetime, AI enablement and budgets.
original_dispositions.rationale: P0 target/quota/retention/TTL settings retained; new AI budgets deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Manage runners and webhook trigger tokens (enroll, rotate, revoke).
original_dispositions.rationale: Scoped runner/trigger credential lifecycle retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Manage the infra map, layers, package allow-lists, change windows, and guardrail raises.
original_dispositions.rationale: Declared maps and P0 policy tightening retained; packages/windows deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Infra Automation** nav item after Incidents and before History, reusing the existing nav component, a `lucide-react` icon, and a pending-approvals badge.
original_dispositions.rationale: Sanctioned navigation and pending decision state retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Landing page follows its own information budget (Section 13.3); Dashboard budget unchanged.
original_dispositions.rationale: Feature information budget and Dashboard preservation retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Run detail with step timeline, redacted logs, artifacts with digests, linked briefing.
original_dispositions.rationale: Immutable timeline/log/artifact/report UX retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Approval card embeds the briefing; fully keyboard operable.
original_dispositions.rationale: Keyboard decision UX retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Loading, empty, error, disabled, and degraded states follow Part B4 patterns.
original_dispositions.rationale: Explicit loading/empty/error/disabled/degraded states retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Calm, advisory copy; no "deploy" verbs for Tier 0/1; AI never claims safety.
original_dispositions.rationale: Advisory preflight/handoff copy retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: New primitives live in `src/components/ui/`, appear in `/dev/components`, and have Vitest snapshots.
original_dispositions.rationale: Existing component catalog and tests retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Accessibility smoke (axe and keyboard) for all new routes.
original_dispositions.rationale: Composed-app axe/keyboard qualification retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Assistant panel (Draft/Explain/Review) with AI chip, validator status, diff, and audit link.
original_dispositions.rationale: Assistant panel deferred with Composer.

original_dispositions.original_text: Provenance chip and "Collected by run" link on the report screen's Audit tab.
original_dispositions.rationale: Report provenance links retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Inventory view (units, packages, edges with basis) and Plan view (waves, rationale, open questions).
original_dispositions.rationale: Declared unit/preflight tables adopted; packages/inferred inventory deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Graph view with an equivalent accessible table alternative.
original_dispositions.rationale: Accessible ordered tables adopted; graph rendering deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Maintain `docs/infra-automation/` (Section 15.2).
original_dispositions.rationale: Supported-feature docs directory/versioned references retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: Capability-tiers, autonomy-levels, and guardrail-floors concept pages.
original_dispositions.rationale: Supported tiers/guardrails documented; deferred autonomy modes are limitations.

original_dispositions.original_text: Runner installation guides (Docker, Kubernetes, systemd) and restricted-network guide, with the Terraform/OpenTofu licensing note.
original_dispositions.rationale: Qualified runner/restricted-network setup and licensing documented; unqualified installation profiles deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Workflow schema, infra-map schema, step catalog, API, CLI references generated from source where practical, with docs-CI drift checks.
original_dispositions.rationale: Supported schema/catalog/API/CLI generated references retained; broader map/domain references deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Comparison page: Infra Automation alongside Kestra, Rundeck, Atlantis, Argo CD, GitHub Actions, Terraform Stacks, and AI-agent platforms.
original_dispositions.rationale: Evidence-backed fit/ownership comparison retained; exhaustive marketing matrix deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: AI guide: capabilities, data sent to providers, local-only setup, limitations, and evaluation results.
original_dispositions.rationale: Existing narrative/local-only limits documented; new AI/evaluation guide deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: Package governance guide and failure-signature contribution guide.
original_dispositions.rationale: Package governance/contribution guide deferred with its capability.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Durability:** no loss of run or approval state across restart or crash; fault injection covers crash after every transition.
original_dispositions.rationale: Committed-state fault corpus retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Delivery semantics:** at-least-once with idempotency keys; duplicate completions are harmless.
original_dispositions.rationale: Duplicate delivery safety strengthened with durable receiver operation.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Orchestration overhead (T):** p95 under 1 s between a step finishing and the next server-side step starting, excluding runner time.
original_dispositions.rationale: Reference workload makes target reproducible.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Claim latency (T):** p95 under 2 s from enqueue to claim with 20 online runners.
original_dispositions.rationale: Reference runner workload makes target reproducible.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Capacity (T):** SQLite single node: at least 10 concurrent runs. PostgreSQL: at least 100.
original_dispositions.rationale: SQLite singleton 10-run target adopted; PostgreSQL 100-run target deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Validation latency (T):** p95 under 500 ms for a 50-step workflow.
original_dispositions.rationale: 50-step corpus and reference workload defined.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Isolation:** no cross-project access to any object (tested matrix).
original_dispositions.rationale: Authorization corpus covers trusted identity.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Redaction:** zero known secret patterns in persisted logs, outputs, artifacts, audit, or stored AI summaries.
original_dispositions.rationale: Known corpus scoped; universal secrecy claim avoided.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Graceful degradation:** runner outage, AI failure, narrative failure, or notification failure never corrupts run state or blocks deterministic analysis.
original_dispositions.rationale: Supported runner/narrative/receiver degradation retained; notification subsystem deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Evidence Law:** zero violations from automation-originated reports in CI fixtures.
original_dispositions.rationale: Bounded Evidence Law gate retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Operability:** structured logs without secrets; metrics for runs, step durations, queue depth, runner health, approval wait, AI calls and outcomes (extends NFR-OPS-06).
original_dispositions.rationale: Supported runtime metrics retained; new AI metrics deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Portability:** SQLite and PostgreSQL; additive reversible migrations where practical.
original_dispositions.rationale: Additive SQLite upgrade/recovery adopted; PostgreSQL automation qualification deferred.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Accessibility:** per Section 13.9.
original_dispositions.rationale: Composed-app accessibility gate retained.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Documentation:** not done without Section 15.2 docs.
original_dispositions.rationale: Complete supported-profile docs required; deferred capability docs not claimed.

original_dispositions.original_text: **AI latency (T):** Composer draft p95 under 20 s with a hosted provider; local model results reported, no hard target in v1.
original_dispositions.rationale: Composer latency applies only after AI feature adoption.

original_dispositions.original_text: **AI safety invariants:** unsafe-acceptance, injection-success, order-violation, coverage-error, and unsafe-suggestion rates are **zero** on the corpus; any regression blocks release.
original_dispositions.rationale: New AI orchestration safety corpus deferred with those capabilities.

original_dispositions.original_text: **Planner scale (T):** deterministic plan for up to 200 units and 500 edges in under 2 s; larger inputs degrade with explicit skipped-scope output (NFR-PERF-02).
original_dispositions.rationale: Bounded declared-unit planning adopted;200 units/500 edges scale target deferred to later qualification.
